question: Should this PR be ported as the direct WebChat Stop fix using startedAt as the same-session run-generation boundary, or should it pause for a broader session recovery design?
rationale: The code path mutates persisted session lifecycle state and overlaps a separate compaction/restartRecoveryRuns report, so maintainer intent is needed before resolving conflicts and landing the invariant.

options.title: Port Direct Stop Fix
options.body: Rebase or port the focused direct Stop recovery onto current chat paths, keep the compaction report separate, and rerun focused proof.

options.title: Broaden To Compaction Recovery
options.body: Require this branch to also reproduce and cover the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns context-loss path before merge.

options.title: Pause For Unified Lifecycle Owner
options.body: Hold the PR while maintainers design one stronger run-generation owner for Stop, restart recovery, and compaction races.

recommendation.title: Port Direct Stop Fix
recommendation.body: Rebase or port the focused direct Stop recovery onto current chat paths, keep the compaction report separate, and rerun focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc recently refactored the current chat/gateway paths and already reviewed the lifecycle invariant on this PR.
